acceptanceCriteria: A closed, versioned test-knowledge/1 schema is specified (documentation-corpus-v1.md or a new spec) with numbered requirements; unknown fields, verdicts or trust levels are refused, and records are pinned to a revision and blob digest.
Corpus build joins records to claims (via source anchors), flows/variations and source files without rewriting claim records; stale anchors (blob mismatch) are reported, not joined.

MCP test-coverage, flow proof status and claim/code lookups return the joined tests labelled by trust level; only run+reviewed counts toward coverage or selection, defect blocks selection, and no trust level marks a claim or flow verified (tests pin each rule).
Focused tests via heavy.sh, dogfood CEM, build-log entry; Closes #1162.
body: GitHub #1162. The documentation corpus links claims/flows only to e2e browser runs; unit/request/component/legacy test knowledge has no place, so claim validation stamps stay empty, flow proof status reports tests: [] for flows proven by reviewed non-browser examples, test coverage returns no_result for unit test files, and partial matches are lost. Proposal: closed versioned input test-knowledge/1 (one record per example: repo, file, line, framework kind, source anchors, entry boundary, actor, setup/stubs, behaviour + asserted values, flow/variation ids, verdict bound|partial|unrelated|defect, gap, docs consistency, receipt ref, pinned revision) with closed trust level run+reviewed|run-unreviewed|read-only|legacy-reference. Only run+reviewed counts toward coverage/selection; defect blocks selection; no level marks a claim or flow verified. Join at build time without rewriting claims; expose in MCP query tools labelled by trust; optional marked generated per-flow section; schema-validation gate. Related #31, #399, #340.
title: GH #1162: docs corpus: ingest reviewed test-knowledge records from any test framework, with closed trust levels, joined to claims, flows and source anchors
